reviews.title: Whisper-Quiet Cooling: The Ultimate Fan for Limited Connections!
reviews.comment: The Thermalright TL-C12B-S V3 CPU Fan is fantastic! It operates quietly, making it an excellent choice for building a peaceful setup. One of the standout features is the ability to daisy chain multiple fans together, which is a real game-changer for those with motherboards that have limited fan connections. This flexibility not only simplifies cable management but also enhances cooling efficiency without cluttering the workspace. Overall, I'm thoroughly impressed with the performance and functionality of these fans! Love the colors since they are RGB capable. The only con is that the fan screws seem like they get stripped after screwing in the fans once. Possibly bigger or wider screws would help that issue.
reviews.author: Trust Me

reviews.title: Great Fans Great Price
reviews.comment: I wasn't looking to spend too much on White ARGB Fans so these were a great choice in my opinion. For the price I don't think I'd recommend any other packs of 3 other than these. They look great, perform well, are easy to install and don't add much more noise than what my PC already made. Ill say it again G great value for a 3 pack of White ARGB Fans
